parameters.jsCode: const cfg=$('Allowed Source + Canonical Store').item.json; const input=$json; const body=input.body ?? input.data ?? input; const canonical=typeof body==='string'?body:JSON.stringify(body); if(canonical.length>200000) throw new Error('SOURCE_TOO_LARGE_FOR_SAFE_CHANGE_DETECTION'); const crypto=require('crypto'); const content_hash=crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonical).digest('hex'); const store=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); store.watcher_fingerprint=store.watcher_fingerprint||{}; const previous=store.watcher_fingerprint[cfg.subject_id]; const change_state=previous===undefined?'NEW':(previous===content_hash?'UNCHANGED':'CHANGED'); store.watcher_fingerprint[cfg.subject_id]=content_hash; let parsed={}; try{parsed=typeof body==='string'?JSON.parse(body):body}catch(_){parsed={raw:body};} const claims=Array.isArray(parsed.claims)?parsed.claims:[]; const claim_kind=claims.length?'assumption':'unknown'; const observation_id=`obs-${cfg.subject_id}-${$execution.id}-${content_hash}`; return [{json:{observation_id,subject_id:cfg.subject_id,source_url:cfg.url,observed_at:new Date().toISOString(),access_method:'GET',evidence_kind:'real',claim_kind,state:'observed',limitation:cfg.limitation,correlation_id:$execution.id,content_hash,change_state,value:parsed,claims,source_authority_or_role:'unverified_public_source',transformation_or_method:'m06-json-parser/v1; no seller claim promoted to fact',canonical_store_url:cfg.canonical_store_url,watcher_cache_only:false}}];

const o=$json; if(!o.observation_id||!o.subject_id||!o.source_url||!o.observed_at||!o.correlation_id) throw new Error('canonical Observation incomplete'); const value=o.value&&typeof o.value==='object'?o.value:{}; const record_id=`watch-${o.subject_id}-${o.correlation_id}`; const formula_version='commission-per-order/v1'; const price=typeof value.price==='number'?value.price:null; const commission_rate=typeof value.commission_rate==='number'?value.commission_rate:null; const product_name=String(value.product_name||value.title||o.subject_id); const observation={observation_id:o.observation_id,subject_id:o.subject_id,source_url:o.source_url,observed_at:o.observed_at,access_method:'GET',evidence_kind:'real',claim_kind:'unknown',state:'observed',source_authority_or_role:o.source_authority_or_role||'unverified_public_source',transformation_or_method:'m06-json-parser/v2; seller claims remain unknown until independently classified',correlation_id:o.correlation_id,limitation:o.limitation,product_id:o.subject_id,product_name,price,commission_rate,currency:String(value.currency||'UNKNOWN')}; const observations=[observation]; const crypto=require('crypto'); const input_hash=crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(observations)).digest('hex'); const ranked=price!==null&&commission_rate!==null?[{product_id:o.subject_id,product_name,score:price*commission_rate}]:[]; const recorded_result={decision_id:record_id,evidence_ids:[observation.observation_id],formula_version,state:ranked.length?'RANK_SCENARIO':'GET_MORE_DATA',ranked,missing_evidence:ranked.length?null:['thiếu price hoặc commission_rate'],reasons:ranked?['baseline chỉ xếp hạng scenario bằng price × commission_rate']:['input còn thiếu hoặc không hợp lệ; cần bổ sung trước khi tin vào ranking'],evidence_mode:'real'}; return [{json:{record:{record_id,as_of:o.observed_at,ingested_at:o.observed_at,formula_version,input_hash,observations,recorded_result},canonical_store_url:o.canonical_store_url}}];

nodes.name: Canonical History Adapter
nodes.notes: The workflow hands a validated HistoryRecord to the local BR-13 canonical history adapter. It does not claim persistence until the adapter returns an ACK.

parameters.jsCode: const response=$json; const status=response.status||response.result; if(status!=='APPENDED'&&status!=='EXACT_DUPLICATE'&&status!=='ACK') throw new Error('CANONICAL_HISTORY_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED'); return [{json:{...response,canonical_history_handoff:'ACK',canonical_history_persisted:true,execution_permitted:false}}];
